headline: When is it Time to Call for Professional Soot Cleanup?
articleBody: Knowing when to call in the pros for soot cleanup can save you a lot of headache, and potentially your property. If you're seeing widespread black residue on walls, ceilings, or personal belongings, it's definitely a sign. Beyond just visual cues, that lingering smoky odor is a huge indicator that soot has infiltrated your property deeply. You might not see all of it, but you can certainly smell it. Another signal is if your HVAC system ran during or after the fire; soot particles can get circulated throughout your entire home or business, impacting air quality significantly. If sensitive materials like electronics, artwork, or delicate fabrics have been exposed, professional intervention is critical to prevent permanent damage. Also, if you’re unsure about the source of the fire or the types of materials burned, professional testing might be needed before any cleaning begins, as different types of soot require different approaches.
